## Featured Projects

*   **[colony-opt](pages/projects.qmd#colony-opt):** Explored optimal resource allocation strategies for ant colonies at varying levels of complexity and under different competitive constraints.
*   **[pharma-state](pages/projects.qmd#pharma-state):** Presented a two-stage machine learning pipeline to model the physical responses of 1,000 patients to propofol during surgery and identify demographic correlations to the anesthetic.
*   **[glymphatic-ode](pages/projects.qmd#glymphatic-ode):** Developed and analyzed ODE models of the glymphatic system to investigate efficient sleep strategies and examine the potential to recover lost sleep.
*   **[taxi-predict](pages/projects.qmd#taxi-predict):** Addressed operational uncertainty in the NYC taxi network by leveraging a random forest regression model against millions of TLC trip records to predict route duration and aid in next-location strategies.
